name: Maret Duvall
found: The Gilded Ash Inn, behind the bar; account books at close.
sayings: Leave your god at the door.
does_not_want: Factions recruiting in her common room.
dreams: Her daughter takes over the inn; her son goes somewhere safer.
oddly_also: Knows which faction every regular belongs to and seats them accordingly.
knows: Everything said in her common room.
family: Husband Bren runs the kitchen; 2 teenagers work the inn. Raised Orthodox; never speaks of it.
anecdotes: Threw Vraed's men and two Schismatics out simultaneously last Waterday, without calling the watch.
tragedies: Her brother joined the Schismatics last year.
